record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Quiver Gauge Theory
record.context_brief: Role of tau_R in dessins and Galois theory
record.original_question: Does the modular parameter tau_R, defined from R-charges via isoradial embedding of a brane tiling, have a role within the theory of dessins d’enfants or more broadly in Galois theory?

evidence.quote: Question 25. Does τR have use in the theory of dessins d’enfants, or further in Galois theory?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A brane tiling is a bipartite graph G drawn on a two-torus T^2 = R^2/Z^2 whose faces are 2-coloured. To each edge e of G one assigns a positive real number R_e in (0,1), called an R-charge, such that for every vertex v one has sum_{e ni v} R_e = 1 (the marginality condition) and for every face f one has sum_{e in partial f} (1 - R_e) = 2 (the anomaly cancellation condition). Given such an R-charge distribution, the tiling admits an isoradial embedding in which every edge e subtends an angle pi R_e at the center of each adjacent face; this construction realises G as the bipartite graph dual to a dessin d'enfant on a Riemann surface, and the complex structure on the resulting elliptic curve is encoded by a modular parameter tau_R in the upper half-plane H, well-defined modulo PSL(2,Z), depending only on the data (G, {R_e}).

Question: Determine whether the assignment (G, {R_e}) -> tau_R in H/PSL(2,Z) plays an intrinsic role in the theory of dessins d'enfants — for instance whether tau_R coincides with, or is naturally related to, the j-invariant of the Belyi curve associated with the underlying dessin — and whether this assignment is compatible with, or detects, the natural action of the absolute Galois group Gal(Qbar/Q) on dessins d'enfants. More concretely: does the orbit of tau_R under Gal(Qbar/Q) lie in the modular orbit of the j-invariant of the corresponding Belyi pair, and can tau_R be used to distinguish Galois orbits of dessins?
artifact.status_search_result: No published work was located that resolves the role of the isoradial modular parameter tau_R in the theory of dessins d'enfants or in the Galois action on them; the question appears to remain open.
